# Circular phylogeny

```{r circular-phylogeny}
st_colors <- setNames(hues::iwanthue(length(major_sts)), major_sts)
cluster_colors <- setNames(
  hues::iwanthue(
    length(cluster_track_levels),
    hmin = 0,
    hmax = 360,
    cmin = 70,
    cmax = 180,
    lmin = 55,
    lmax = 90
  ),
  cluster_track_levels
)
profile_colors <- setNames(
  hues::iwanthue(
    length(profile_track_levels),
    hmin = 0,
    hmax = 360,
    cmin = 60,
    cmax = 180,
    lmin = 20,
    lmax = 58
  ),
  profile_track_levels
)
track_colors <- c(
  st_colors,
  "Other ST" = "#FFFFFF",
  cluster_colors,
  "Cluster gap" = "#FFFFFF",
  profile_colors,
  "Profile gap" = "#FFFFFF"
)

circular_selection <- phylogeny_track_data %>%
  transmute(
    Isolate = genome_id,
    chosen_isolate = selected
  )

circular_tree <- ggtree(
  tree,
  layout = "circular",
  branch.length = "none",
  linewidth = 0.075
) %<+%
  circular_selection +
  geom_tippoint(
    aes(subset = chosen_isolate),
    color = phylogeny_selected_color,
    size = 0.1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  )

# Center the largest contiguous run of minor/Other-ST tips at 12 o'clock,
# creating a gap in the annotation rings for their numbered labels.
largest_circular_run <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  if (all(x)) return(seq_len(n))
  runs <- rle(c(x, x))
  run_ends <- cumsum(runs$lengths)
  run_starts <- run_ends - runs$lengths + 1
  candidates <- which(runs$values & run_starts <= n)
  best <- candidates[which.max(runs$lengths[candidates])]
  ((seq.int(run_starts[best], length.out = runs$lengths[best]) - 1) %% n) + 1
}

circular_tip_order <- circular_tree$data %>%
  filter(isTip) %>%
  transmute(genome_id = label, y) %>%
  left_join(
    phylogeny_track_data %>% select(genome_id, st_track),
    by = "genome_id"
  ) %>%
  arrange(y)

minor_gap_indices <- largest_circular_run(
  circular_tip_order$st_track == "Other ST"
)
minor_gap_center <- (
  minor_gap_indices[1] - 1 + (length(minor_gap_indices) - 1) / 2
) %% nrow(circular_tip_order) + 1
minor_gap_rotation <- 360 * (minor_gap_center - 0.5) /
  nrow(circular_tip_order)

circular_tree <- gheatmap(
  circular_tree,
  phylogeny_tracks,
  width = 0.12,
  offset = 0,
  color = NA,
  colnames = FALSE
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = track_colors,
    breaks = c(major_sts, "Other ST")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

circular_tree <- ggtree::rotate_tree(
  circular_tree,
  angle = minor_gap_rotation
)
```

# Track legends and output

```{r output, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
st_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  make_track_legend(
    levels = c(major_sts, "Other ST"),
    colors = c(st_colors, "Other ST" = "#FFFFFF"),
    labels = c(major_sts, "Other ST"),
    title = "1. ST",
    ncol = 6
  )
)

cluster_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  make_track_legend(
    levels = cluster_track_levels,
    colors = cluster_colors,
    labels = as.character(seq_along(cluster_track_levels)),
    title = "2. AA-based clusters",
    ncol = 6
  )
)

profile_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  make_track_legend(
    levels = profile_track_levels,
    colors = profile_colors,
    labels = as.character(seq_along(profile_track_levels)),
    title = "3. Trait-based partitions",
    ncol = 6
  )
)

track_legends <- ggdraw() +
  draw_grob(
    st_legend,
    x = 0.01,
    y = 0.075,
    width = 0.38,
    height = 1,
    valign = 1
  ) +
  draw_grob(
    cluster_legend,
    x = 0.42,
    y = 0.01,
    width = 0.38,
    height = 1,
    valign = 1
  ) +
  draw_grob(
    profile_legend,
    x = 0.715,
    y = 0.19,
    width = 0.38,
    height = 1,
    valign = 1
  )

figure_s2 <- ggdraw(
  xlim = c(0, 1),
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  clip = "on"
) +
  draw_plot(
    circular_tree,
    x = -0.159,
    y = 0.075,
    width = 1.318,
    height = 1.017
  ) +
  draw_plot(
    track_legends,
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    width = 1,
    height = 2 / 12
  ) +
  draw_grob(
    grid::rectGrob(gp = grid::gpar(col = NA, fill = "white")),
    x = 0.491,
    y = 0.942,
    width = 0.018,
    height = 0.052
  ) +
  draw_label("1", x = 0.5, y = 0.955, size = 8) +
  draw_label("2", x = 0.5, y = 0.969, size = 8) +
  draw_label("3", x = 0.5, y = 0.983, size = 8)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path('figures/s_figure_4_overall_phylogeny.png'),
  plot = figure_s2,
  width = 10,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
